news.title: Geri-Action makes its world premiere at the Independent Shorts Awards
news.body:
Geri-Action, Rare Pond's breakout proof-of-concept short, had its world premiere on September 19 at the Independent Shorts Awards, screening at Regal LA LIVE in downtown Los Angeles as part of a special non-competitive showcase.

It was the first time the film played to a real audience on a real cinema screen, which meant finishing a proper DCP from the 4K master (thank you, The DCP Works) and a long night of meeting the other filmmakers in the room. Geri-Action also carries the festival's **Official Selection** laurel for 2026.

The festival run is just getting started. Follow [@geri_action_film](https://www.instagram.com/geri_action_film/) for screening news, and visit the [Geri-Action page](/geriaction) for stills and credits.

news.title: Rare Pond at the 50th Ottawa International Animation Festival
news.body:
Rare Pond spent the last week of September in Ottawa for the 50th edition of the Ottawa International Animation Festival, September 23 to 27, where Jack sat down with the Animation Platform for an interview about the studio.

The conversation covers how Rare Pond builds its little universes across live action and animation, and what is coming next. The interview has not been posted yet; this article will be updated with the link the moment it is.

The rest of the week was screenings, talks and a lot of conversations with animators, studios and programmers from across the industry. New friends of the pond, all of them.

news.title: Geri-Action is an Official Selection of Indie Short Fest 2026
news.body:
Geri-Action has been named an **Official Selection of Indie Short Fest 2026**, its second festival selection of the year after the Independent Shorts Awards.

Indie Short Fest is a Los Angeles festival that runs monthly editions through the year, with selected films qualifying for its annual live screening and awards. The laurel now sits on the [Geri-Action page](/geriaction), where every festival update lands first.
